title: The structure of variational autoencoder latent spaces and its consequences for representation and optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.19972v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Variational autoencoders (VAEs) are widely used to build low-dimensional representations of scientific data, with the expectation that regularization yields smooth coordinates for interpolation, generation and optimization. However, applications in microscopy reveal domains, narrow transitions and rare-state islands in VAE latent spaces that smoothness alone does not explain. We show that, for prototype data with squared-error reconstruction and an optimal decoder, the latent-space objective has a direct correspondence with the Flory-Huggins theory of a regular solution, and use it to analyze how the objective, posterior distributions and latent dimensionality organize the representation. Data families occupy domains separated by finite-width walls that broaden with increasing regularization until class separation is lost through posterior collapse. translated_title: 变分自编码器潜在空间的结构及其对表示和优化的影响
translated_abstract: 变分自编码器（VAE）被广泛用于构建科学数据的低维表示，人们期望正则化能产生用于插值、生成和优化的平滑坐标。然而，在显微镜学中的应用揭示了VAE潜在空间中存在畴区、窄过渡带和稀有态孤岛，这些现象仅凭平滑性无法解释。我们证明，对于具有平方误差重建和最优解码器的原型数据，潜在空间目标函数与正规溶液的Flory-Huggins理论存在直接对应关系，并利用这一对应关系分析目标函数、后验分布和潜在维度如何组织表示。数据族占据由有限宽度壁分隔的畴区，随着正则化增强，这些壁不断变宽，直到通过后验坍缩使类别分离消失。类别质心的行为类似于谐振势阱中的粒子：先验对其加以约束……
tldr: 该论文揭示VAE潜在空间中存在畴区、过渡带等结构，并证明其目标函数与Flory-Huggins正规溶液理论直接对应，由此解释了正则化强度如何控制畴壁宽度和后验坍缩等潜在空间组织机制。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals domain-like structures in VAE latent spaces and demonstrates a direct correspondence between the latent-space objective and Flory-Huggins regular solution theory, explaining how regularization controls domain wall broadening and posterior collapse in latent representations.
